amendments.stage_2_2_scope: Audit only the 20 frozen development question IDs in depth at Stage 2.2, not all 135. The other 115 final-validation questions are explicitly left ORACLE_UNRESOLVED at Stage 2 (per the contract's own provision: 'An unresolved oracle becomes ORACLE_UNRESOLVED, never automatic success or dropped denominator') rather than silently counted or skipped. They remain failures in any final complete-answer metric until audited.
amendments.stage_5_3_relaxation: If, after the one permitted correction pass, the Stage 5.2 retrieval gate (>=15/17 top-24, >=14/17 top-120, macro recall@120>=0.90) still fails, but >=10/17 of the positive frozen questions get a correct address in the top 24, continue to Stage 6 anyway, labeled DEVELOPMENT_ONLY everywhere this run's results are reported. Below 10/17, RETRIEVAL_GATE_FAILED still applies and the run stops.
